title: Spec-Test Coverage Gap: Detecting Overspecified Tests in SWE-Bench-Style Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2611.31839v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: SWE-bench-style benchmarks, such as SWE-bench Verified (Verified) and SWE-bench Pro (Pro), evaluate coding agents with tests taken from the change that originally fixed each issue. However, these tests can enforce details the task never states, causing correct alternative fixes to fail. Such overspecified tests have so far been found mainly through expensive expert review. To address this, we define the Spec-Test Coverage Gap (STCG), a 1-4 scale measuring overspecification, and score it with two LLM judges, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, which are given the specification and the test patch. A task is flagged as overspecified when both judges score it 3 or higher. Our study has three parts. First, we validate the judges on 206 tasks that earlier human audits and agent results label as overspecified or fine. Second, we apply STCG to all 500 Verified and 731 public Pro tasks and compare the flags with the results of the top 30 Verified

translated_title: 规格-测试覆盖差距：检测SWE-Bench风格基准中的过度指定测试
translated_abstract: SWE-bench风格的基准测试，例如SWE-bench Verified（Verified）和SWE-bench Pro（Pro），使用源自最初修复各问题的变更中的测试来评估编码智能体。然而，这些测试可能会强制执行任务描述中从未说明的细节，导致正确的替代修复方案失败。迄今为止，这类过度指定的测试主要通过昂贵的专家审查来发现。为了解决这一问题，我们定义了规格-测试覆盖差距（STCG），这是一个用于衡量过度指定程度的1-4分制量表，并由两个LLM评判者——Claude Opus 5.5和GPT-6.1 Sol——根据规格说明和测试补丁进行评分。当两个评判者都给出3分或更高分数时，该任务被标记为过度指定。我们的研究包括三个部分。首先，我们在206个任务上验证了评判者，这些任务由早期的人工审计和智能体结果标记为过度指定或正常。其次，我们将STCG应用于全部500个Verified任务和731个公开的Pro任务，并将标记结果与排名前30的Verified（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出规格-测试覆盖差距（STCG）这一1-4分制新指标，利用两个LLM评判者自动检测SWE-bench风格基准中的过度指定测试，从而取代昂贵的专家审查，识别会导致正确的替代修复方案被误判失败的测试用例。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Spec-Test Coverage Gap (STCG), a 1-4 scale metric that uses two LLM judges to automatically detect overspecified tests in SWE-bench-style benchmarks, replacing costly expert review to identify tests that would incorrectly fail valid alternative fixes.
